Location interface (source L1-9): id: string, addressName: string, latitude: number, longitude: number, visitCount: number, totalDurationS: number (SI-canonical seconds, kept as-is per the SI-cutover contract), lastVisited: string | null — all 7 members ported exactly including the nullable lastVisited.

Geofence interface (source L11-22): id: string, name: string, latitude: number, longitude: number, radius: number, alertOnEntry: boolean, alertOnExit: boolean, enabled: boolean, costPerKwh: number | null, createdAt: string — all 10 members ported exactly including the nullable costPerKwh.

Source L10 (blank separator between the two interfaces) and L22 (trailing newline) are accounted for as structural whitespace; no logic, unit conversion, i18n, or runtime behavior exists to adapt for React Native — interfaces are erased at compile time and add zero DOM coupling. camelCase member names are preserved verbatim to keep parity with the web type so consuming native hooks/screens reference identical fields.
